data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for streaming audio data from mic and to audio engine without using a file.
data.what_it_does: It allows streaming raw audio data from the microphone as Uint8List chunks and playing back raw audio streams via an audio engine. Recorder and player can work simultaneously.
use_when: You need to stream audio via a network connection
You want to process microphone input with speech-to-text or text-to-speech functions
You need to play raw PCM 16bit mono audio streams
avoid_when: You need audio formats other than PCM 16bit Mono
You are targeting platforms other than Android and iOS, such as Web, Windows, or macOS
You just want to play back standard audio files easily without dealing with raw streams
strengths: Provides direct streams of mic data as Uint8List
Cross-platform support for Android and iOS
weaknesses: Limited platform support (Android and iOS only)
Plugin is still in early development stage
data.setup_notes: Requires microphone permissions on Android and iOS.

alternatives.name: audioplayers
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to play standard audio files and URLs rather than low-level raw streams.

alternatives.name: record
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a dedicated audio recorder supporting various formats and output configurations.

alternatives.name: just_audio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need feature-rich audio playback with playlist and streaming capabilities.
